answer: In the European Commission’s ‘Artificial Intelligence for Europe’ communication, it was stated that around EUR 1.1 billion was invested in AI-related research and innovation during the period 2014-2017 under the Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme. By the end of 2020, the Commission planned to increase investments in AI under Horizon 2020 to around EUR 1.5 billion, which represents an increase of approximately 70%.
